From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: POC kickoff - Acme Corp

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the context on how Acme is thinking about scaling contextual search and summarization across support and product. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC: 

Pain points you called out:
- Long support resolution times due to unstructured docs and tooling gaps
- High cost per query when using current LLM endpoints (latency and token cost)
- Lack of guardrails around private data in model outputs

Goals for the pilot:
- Improve relevant answer quality for support search by +15 NDCG (baseline TBD)
- Reduce average response latency to <300ms for metered queries
- Demonstrate safe redaction/PII handling in outputs

Suggested POC scope (high level) — if this matches, I’ll share a kickoff recap and owners: 
- Duration: 6 weeks (2-week setup + 4-week evaluation)
- Workloads: support search + summary generation for top-50 KB articles
- Metrics: NDCG@5, latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, recall on redaction checks
- Deliverables: prompt set, evaluation harness, weekly demos, final recommendations

Next steps:
1) Please confirm scope and owners on your side.
2) I’ll loop in Aditya (our solutions engineer) and Rishi (CS lead) for technical access.
3) We’ll share an SOW + project plan and a short prompt set to validate during setup.

I’ve attached the proposed POC scope doc and a short prompt sample for your review (POC_scope.xlsx, prompt_set.csv). If you prefer a different timeline, tell me and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: POC_scope.xlsx]
[Attachment: prompt_set.csv]

Alex / Team —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Below is the kickoff plan and owners (this will be the version we attach to the SOW). I’ll also share a short project plan in HubSpot and a Drive folder with the prompt set and evaluation harness.

POC kickoff recap — Acme Corp & Redwood Inference
Scope (confirmed):
- Workloads: support search (top-50 KB queries) + short-form summarization for triage
- Data: anonymized logs + selected KB articles; no PHI/PII in datasets (we will run a redaction pass)
- Duration: 6 weeks (setup week: Jan 4–8; evaluation: Jan 11–Feb 5) — note: dates adjusted per your preference

Success metrics (examples we’ll measure):
- Relevance: +15 NDCG@5 over baseline (baseline from Acme logs)
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for interactive queries
- Cost: target cost improvement of 25% vs current vendor for equivalent throughput
- Safety: automated redaction 99% recall on test set

Evaluation & prompt set:
- Redwood will provide canonical prompt templates and a seed prompt set (attached: prompt_set.csv).
- We’ll run automated evals daily and hold weekly syncs to review failures and adjust prompts.

Owners & contacts:
- Acme: Alex Johnson (TPM) — alex.johnson@acmecorp.com
- Acme: Priya Menon (Product) — priya.menon@acmecorp.com
- Acme: Michael Lee (Eng) — michael.lee@acmecorp.com
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE) — marissa.cole@redwood.ai
- Redwood: Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer) — aditya.rao@redwood.ai
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (Customer Success) — rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Technical access & setup checklist (Action items):
1) Acme: Provide a deploy user with temporary SSO access for our POC cluster (details: IAM role + jump-host info).
2) Acme: Share a sample of anonymized logs (S3 link) and a small KB export (CSV) — we’ll run a redaction pass.
3) Redwood: Spin up a dedicated POC pool (private tenant) with KMS integration — Aditya to confirm ETA.
4) Both: Confirm test query list and sampling criteria (we’ll seed with top 5k queries).

Attachments included: POC_scope.xlsx, prompt_set.csv, NDA_signed.pdf (already uploaded to Drive).

Links:
- Shared Drive (POC folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-POC
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
- SOW/DocuSign link will follow after you confirm owners

Timeline (high level):
- Dec 21–Jan 3: legal & admin (SOW + access)
- Jan 4–8: setup & initial validation
- Jan 11–Feb 5: evaluation & weekly reviews
- Feb 8: final review & recommendations

Can you confirm the IAM role name and an S3 path for the logs by EOD Wednesday (Dec 23)? If so, Aditya will schedule time on Jan 5 for the infra handoff.

Thanks — I’ll open the HubSpot project and attach these docs.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
